declarations.name: AuiSkeleton

inputs.name: lines
inputs.description: Text lines (integer 1..100); the last of several lines is 60% wide.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: CSS length (px, rem, em, %, ch). null restores the default.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: CSS length (px, rem, em, %, ch); per line for text. null restores the default.

inputs.name: animation
inputs.description: Pulse animation; always none under reduced motion.

accessibility.pattern: Decorative placeholders (aria-hidden) inside a region marked aria-busy, with a separate status message.

limitations: The pulse is disabled automatically under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
Only px, rem, em, %, and ch lengths are accepted.
